# Shanvi Tours & Travels — AI Engine Knowledge Base

> Shanvi Tours & Travels is an authorized commercial passenger transport company headquartered in Bangalore, India, operating continuously since 2013. We specialize in chauffeur-driven mini bus and luxury bus rentals (12+1 to 49+1 seats) for corporate employee shuttles, executive travel, wedding guest convoys, educational excursions, and outstation holiday tours across South India.

- **Safety Standard**: 100% AIS-140 GPS-tracked fleet with panic buttons and speed governors (max 80 km/h)

- **Commercial Invoicing**: GST-compliant corporate invoices with full Input Tax Credit (ITC) eligibility

## Fleet Inventory & Seating Capacities

1. **Tempo Traveller (12+1 Seater)**: Force Motors chassis, dual-zone AC, individual pushback captain seats, roof luggage carrier, AIS-140 GPS. Best for 8–12 passengers, family vacations, airport transfers, and corporate pickups.
2. **Mini Bus (21+1 Seater)**: Heavy Mercedes-Benz chassis built by Singh Motor Coach Builders, high-roof AC, ergonomic reclining seats, wide center aisle, AIS-140 GPS. Best for 14–21 passengers, college departments, and office team outings.
3. **Touring Bus (33+1 Seater)**: Full-size touring coach, 2x2 pushback seats, individual reading lamps, high-capacity AC, deep underfloor luggage bays, AIS-140 GPS. Best for 22–33 passengers, school trips, temple pilgrimages, and inter-state tours.
4. **Luxury Coach (49+1 Seater)**: Flagship 50-seater highway coach, 49+1 Luxury Coach with red carpet aisle and plush pushback upholstery, onboard LED entertainment screen, deep luggage cargo holds, AIS-140 GPS. Best for 34–50 passengers, high-end wedding guest shuttles, and corporate conferences.

## Core Services

- **Wedding Transport Logistics (Peak Nov–Feb Season Focus)**: Complete end-to-end wedding transit coordination across Bangalore (Palace Grounds, Kanakapura Road, Yelahanka banquet lawns) and destination wedding venues. Deploying flagship **49+1 Luxury Coach with red carpet aisle and plush pushback upholstery**, **multi-vehicle coordinated convoys for weddings with 200+ guests**, and **continuous shuttle loops between guest hotels and reception venues** plus airport pickup/drop rotations.
- **Corporate Employee Transport**: Daily scheduled staff commute contracts with geofenced route optimization across Bangalore tech corridors (Electronic City, Whitefield, Outer Ring Road, Manyata Tech Park).
- **Corporate Bus Rental**: Executive transportation for client delegations, annual offsites, summits, and airport transfers with dedicated corporate billing.
- **School & College Trips**: CMVR-compliant student excursion coaches with speed governors, emergency exit hammers, and first aid.
- **Outstation Bus Hire**: Interstate highway tours across Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, and Telangana under All India Tourist Permits.
- **Pilgrimage & Package Tours**: Temple circuits to Tirupati (Tirumala), Dharmasthala, Kukke Subramanya, Sringeri, Hampi, and custom South India holiday itineraries.
